```
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.10"
# dependencies = ["markdown-it-py>=3"]
# ///
"""Render the exported agent sessions (docs/agent-log/*.md) as local HTML pages.

A local viewer for people with access to the repository; nothing is published. The
SessionEnd hook (.claude/hooks/export-session.sh) writes one Markdown file per session;
this script reads those files back into turns (prompts, answers, thinking, tool calls with
their results, subagents) and writes a browsable site:

    uv run tools/agent_log_html.py            # writes build/agent-log/, prints the index path
    uv run tools/agent_log_html.py --open     # and opens it in the browser

The output folder is git-ignored. Sessions without a prompt are skipped.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import html
import json
import re
import sys
import webbrowser
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from markdown_it import MarkdownIt

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LOG_DIR = ROOT / "docs" / "agent-log"
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "build" / "agent-log"

MD = MarkdownIt("commonmark", {"html": False, "linkify": False}).enable("table").enable("strikethrough")

TURN = re.compile(r"^(#{2,3}) (User|Assistant|System) <sub>(.*?)</sub>\s*$")
SUBAGENT = re.compile(r"^## Subagent `([^`]+)`(?:: (.*))?\s*$")
SUBAGENT_TYPE = re.compile(r"^Type: `([^`]*)`")
FENCE = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$")
TOOL_CALL = re.compile(r"^\*\*Tool call:\*\* `([^`]+)` <sub>([^<]+)</sub>\s*$")
RESULT_SUMMARY = re.compile(r"^<summary>\*\*Tool result( \(error\))?\*\* <sub>([^<]+)</sub></summary>\s*$")
REMINDER = re.compile(r"&lt;system-reminder&gt;(.*?)&lt;/system-reminder&gt;", re.S)
META_ROW = re.compile(r"^\| (.+?) \| (.*) \|\s*$")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- model
@dataclass
class Segment:
    kind: str  # text | thinking | tool | result | system
    text: str = ""
    name: str = ""
    tool_id: str = ""
    inputs: list[tuple[str, str, bool]] = field(default_factory=list)  # (key, value, multiline)
    error: bool = False
    result: "Segment | None" = None


@dataclass
class Turn:
    role: str  # User | Assistant | System
    time: str
    segments: list[Segment] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class Subagent:
    name: str
    description: str
    agent_type: str
    turns: list[Turn] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class Session:
    sid: str
    meta: dict[str, str]
    turns: list[Turn]
    subagents: list[Subagent]

    @property
    def prompts(self) -> list[Turn]:
        return [t for t in self.turns if t.role == "User"]

    @property
    def tool_calls(self) -> int:
        all_turns = self.turns + [t for s in self.subagents for t in s.turns]
        return sum(1 for t in all_turns for s in t.segments if s.kind == "tool")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- parsing
class FenceTracker:
    """Knows whether a line is inside a fenced code block (CommonMark rules, simplified)."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.open: str | None = None

    def step(self, line: str) -> bool:
        """Feed a line; True if it is inside a fence or is a fence line itself."""
        m = FENCE.match(line)
        if self.open is None:
            if m and not (m.group(1)[0] == "`" and "`" in m.group(2)):
                self.open = m.group(1)
                return True
            return False
        if m and m.group(1)[0] == self.open[0] and len(m.group(1)) >= len(self.open) and not m.group(2).strip():
            self.open = None
        return True


def parse_inputs(lines: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str, str, bool]]:
    """The hook writes inputs as "- `key`: `value`" or "- `key`:" followed by a fenced block."""
    out: list[tuple[str, str, bool]] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        inline = re.match(r"^- `([^`]+)`: `(.*)`\s*$", line)
        block = re.match(r"^- `([^`]+)`:\s*$", line)
        if inline:
            out.append((inline.group(1), inline.group(2), False))
            i += 1
            continue
        if block:
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(lines) and not lines[j].strip():
                j += 1
            fence = FENCE.match(lines[j]) if j < len(lines) else None
            if fence:
                marker = fence.group(1)
                k = j + 1
                body: list[str] = []
                while k < len(lines) and not (lines[k].startswith(marker) and not lines[k][len(marker):].strip()):
                    body.append(lines[k])
                    k += 1
                out.append((block.group(1), "\n".join(body), True))
                i = k + 1
                continue
        if line.strip():
            out.append(("", line, True))
        i += 1
    return out


def parse_segments(lines: list[str]) -> list[Segment]:
    segments: list[Segment] = []
    fence = FenceTracker()
    buf: list[str] = []
    i = 0

    def flush_text() -> None:
        text = "\n".join(buf).strip()
        if text:
            if text.startswith("> **system"):
                segments.append(Segment("system", text=text.removeprefix("> ")))
            else:
                segments.append(Segment("text", text=text))
        buf.clear()

    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if fence.open is None:
            call = TOOL_CALL.match(line)
            nxt = lines[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(lines) else ""
            if call:
                flush_text()
                j = i + 1
                body: list[str] = []
                inner = FenceTracker()
                while j < len(lines):
                    if inner.open is None and (TOOL_CALL.match(lines[j]) or lines[j].strip() == "<details>"):
                        break
                    inner.step(lines[j])
                    body.append(lines[j])
                    j += 1
                segments.append(Segment("tool", name=call.group(1), tool_id=call.group(2).strip(), inputs=parse_inputs(body)))
                i = j
                continue
            if line.strip() == "<details>" and (nxt.startswith("<summary>Thinking</summary>") or RESULT_SUMMARY.match(nxt)):
                flush_text()
                result = RESULT_SUMMARY.match(nxt)
                j = i + 2
                body = []
                inner = FenceTracker()
                while j < len(lines) and not (inner.open is None and lines[j].strip() == "</details>"):
                    inner.step(lines[j])
                    body.append(lines[j])
                    j += 1
                text = "\n".join(body).strip()
                if result:
                    m = re.match(r"^(`{3,})\n(.*)\n\1$", text, re.S)
                    segments.append(Segment("result", text=m.group(2) if m else text, tool_id=result.group(2).strip(),
                                            error=bool(result.group(1))))
                else:
                    segments.append(Segment("thinking", text=text))
                i = j + 1
                continue
        fence.step(line)
        buf.append(line)
        i += 1
    flush_text()

    # Attach each result to its call; a result without a call stays on its own.
    calls = {s.tool_id: s for s in segments if s.kind == "tool"}
    kept = []
    for s in segments:
        if s.kind == "result" and s.tool_id in calls and calls[s.tool_id].result is None:
            calls[s.tool_id].result = s
        else:
            kept.append(s)
    return kept


def parse_session(path: Path) -> Session:
    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").replace("\x00", "").split("\n")
    meta: dict[str, str] = {}
    turns: list[Turn] = []
    subagents: list[Subagent] = []
    current: Turn | None = None
    body: list[str] = []
    fence = FenceTracker()
    target = turns

    def close() -> None:
        nonlocal current
        if current is not None:
            current.segments = parse_segments(body)
            # The hook merges records of the same role; join a turn split by a subagent boundary.
            target.append(current)
        current = None
        body.clear()

    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        if current is None and not turns and not subagents:
            row = META_ROW.match(line)
            if row and row.group(1).strip() not in ("", "---"):
                meta[row.group(1).strip()] = row.group(2).strip().strip("`")
        if fence.open is None:
            turn = TURN.match(line)
            sub = SUBAGENT.match(line)
            if turn:
                close()
                current = Turn(turn.group(2), turn.group(3))
                continue
            if sub:
                close()
                agent_type = ""
                for look in lines[idx + 1 : idx + 4]:
                    t = SUBAGENT_TYPE.match(look)
                    if t:
                        agent_type = t.group(1)
                subagents.append(Subagent(sub.group(1), (sub.group(2) or "").strip(), agent_type))
                target = subagents[-1].turns
                continue
            if current is not None and line.strip() == "---" and idx + 2 < len(lines) and SUBAGENT.match(lines[idx + 2]):
                continue
        if current is not None:
            fence.step(line)
            body.append(line)
    close()
    return Session(path.stem, meta, turns, subagents)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- rendering
def esc(s: str) -> str:
    return html.escape(s, quote=True)


def when(ts: str, with_date: bool = False) -> str:
    try:
        d = datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return esc(ts)
    return d.strftime("%b %-d, %H:%M") if with_date else d.strftime("%H:%M")


def duration(a: str, b: str) -> str:
    try:
        start = datetime.fromisoformat(a.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        end = datetime.fromisoformat(b.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return ""
    minutes = int((end - start).total_seconds() // 60)
    return f"{minutes // 60} h {minutes % 60:02d} min" if minutes >= 60 else f"{minutes} min"


DESCRIPTORS = ("description", "command", "file_path", "path", "pattern", "query", "url", "skill", "prompt", "questions")


def descriptor(seg: Segment) -> str:
    values = {k: v for k, v, _ in seg.inputs}
    for key in DESCRIPTORS:
        if values.get(key):
            first = values[key].strip().split("\n")[0]
            return first[:140] + ("…" if len(first) > 140 else "")
    return ""


def render_prompt(text: str) -> str:
    """A user prompt: injected context (system reminders) collapsed, the rest as Markdown."""
    chunks: list[str] = []
    pos = 0
    for m in REMINDER.finditer(text):
        before = text[pos : m.start()].strip()
        if before:
            chunks.append(MD.render(html.unescape(before)))
        chunks.append(
            '<details class="ctx"><summary>Injected context</summary><pre>'
            + esc(html.unescape(m.group(1).strip()))
            + "</pre></details>"
        )
        pos = m.end()
    rest = text[pos:].strip()
    if rest:
        chunks.append(MD.render(html.unescape(rest)))
    return "\n".join(chunks)


def render_tool(seg: Segment, links: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    error = seg.result is not None and seg.result.error
    summary = (
        f'<span class="tool__name">{esc(seg.name)}</span>'
        f'<span class="tool__what">{esc(descriptor(seg))}</span>'
        + ('<span class="tool__flag">error</span>' if error else "")
        + ("" if seg.result is not None else '<span class="tool__flag tool__flag--quiet">no result</span>')
    )
    rows = []
    for key, value, multiline in seg.inputs:
        cell = f"<pre>{esc(value)}</pre>" if multiline or len(value) > 120 else f"<code>{esc(value)}</code>"
        rows.append(f"<dt>{esc(key)}</dt><dd>{cell}</dd>")
    link = links.get(dict((k, v) for k, v, _ in seg.inputs).get("description", ""), "")
    result = ""
    if seg.result is not None:
        result = f'<div class="tool__result{" tool__result--error" if error else ""}"><span class="kicker">Result</span><pre>{esc(seg.result.text)}</pre></div>'
    sub = f'<p class="tool__sub"><a href="#{link}">Open this subagent’s transcript ↓</a></p>' if link else ""
    return (
        f'<details class="tool{" tool--error" if error else ""}"><summary>{summary}</summary>'
        f'<div class="tool__body"><dl class="tool__input">{"".join(rows)}</dl>{sub}{result}</div></details>'
    )


def render_turn(turn: Turn, number: int | None, links: dict[str, str], anchor: str) -> str:
    if turn.role == "System":
        text = " ".join(s.text for s in turn.segments)
        return f'<div class="sys" id="{anchor}"><span class="sys__time">{when(turn.time)}</span>{MD.render(text)}</div>'
    if turn.role == "User":
        text = "\n\n".join(s.text for s in turn.segments if s.kind in ("text", "system"))
        label = f"Prompt {number}" if number else "Prompt"
        return (
            f'<article class="turn turn--user" id="{anchor}"><header class="turn__head"><span class="turn__who">{label}</span>'
            f'<time>{when(turn.time, True)}</time></header><div class="prose">{render_prompt(text)}</div></article>'
        )
    parts = []
    for s in turn.segments:
        if s.kind == "text":
            parts.append(f'<div class="prose">{MD.render(html.unescape(s.text))}</div>')
        elif s.kind == "thinking":
            parts.append(f'<details class="thinking"><summary>Thinking</summary><div class="prose">{MD.render(html.unescape(s.text))}</div></details>')
        elif s.kind == "tool":
            parts.append(render_tool(s, links))
        elif s.kind == "result":
            parts.append(f'<details class="tool"><summary><span class="tool__name">Result</span></summary><pre>{esc(s.text)}</pre></details>')
        elif s.kind == "system":
            parts.append(f'<div class="sys">{MD.render(s.text)}</div>')
    return (
        f'<article class="turn turn--agent" id="{anchor}"><header class="turn__head"><span class="turn__who">Claude</span>'
        f'<time>{when(turn.time)}</time></header>{"".join(parts)}</article>'
    )


def first_line(turn: Turn, limit: int = 90) -> str:
    text = REMINDER.sub("", "\n".join(s.text for s in turn.segments if s.kind == "text"))
    text = html.unescape(re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)).strip()
    return text[:limit] + ("…" if len(text) > limit else "")


def page(title: str, body: str, depth: int = 0) -> str:
    up = "../" * depth
    return f"""<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{esc(title)}</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{up}assets/style.css"></head>
<body>{body}<script src="{up}assets/app.js"></script></body></html>
"""


def render_session(s: Session) -> str:
    links: dict[str, str] = {}
    for i, sub in enumerate(s.subagents):
        if sub.description:
            links.setdefault(sub.description, f"sub-{i + 1}")
    toc, turns = [], []
    n = 0
    for i, t in enumerate(s.turns):
        anchor = f"t{i}"
        if t.role == "User":
            n += 1
            anchor = f"p{n}"
            toc.append(f'<li><a href="#{anchor}"><span class="toc__n">{n}</span><span class="toc__t">{esc(first_line(t, 70))}</span></a></li>')
        turns.append(render_turn(t, n if t.role == "User" else None, links, anchor))
    subs = []
    for i, sub in enumerate(s.subagents):
        inner = "".join(render_turn(t, None, links, f"sub-{i + 1}-t{j}") for j, t in enumerate(sub.turns))
        subs.append(
            f'<details class="subagent" id="sub-{i + 1}"><summary><span class="tool__name">{esc(sub.agent_type or "subagent")}</span>'
            f'<span class="tool__what">{esc(sub.description or sub.name)}</span></summary><div class="subagent__body">{inner}</div></details>'
        )
    meta = s.meta
    started, last = meta.get("Started", ""), meta.get("Last record", "")
    facts = [
        ("Started", when(started, True)),
        ("Length", duration(started, last)),
        ("Prompts", str(len(s.prompts))),
        ("Tool calls", f"{s.tool_calls:,}"),
        ("Subagents", str(len(s.subagents))),
        ("Branch", esc(meta.get("Branch", ""))),
    ]
    strip = "".join(f'<div class="fact"><span class="kicker">{k}</span><span class="fact__v">{v}</span></div>' for k, v in facts)
    body = f"""
<header class="mast"><a class="mast__back" href="../index.html">← All sessions</a>
<h1>Session <code>{esc(s.sid[:8])}</code></h1><div class="facts">{strip}</div>
<div class="controls"><button type="button" data-toggle="tool">Expand tool calls</button>
<button type="button" data-toggle="thinking">Expand thinking</button></div></header>
<div class="layout"><nav class="toc" aria-label="Prompts"><p class="kicker">Prompts</p>
<input type="search" class="toc__filter" placeholder="Filter prompts" aria-label="Filter prompts"><ol>{"".join(toc)}</ol></nav>
<main class="log">{"".join(turns)}{f'<h2 class="subs__h">Subagents ({len(subs)})</h2>' + "".join(subs) if subs else ""}</main></div>
"""
    return page(f"Session {s.sid[:8]}", body, depth=1)


def render_index(sessions: list[Session]) -> str:
    rows = []
    for s in sessions:
        started, last = s.meta.get("Started", ""), s.meta.get("Last record", "")
        first = first_line(s.prompts[0], 160) if s.prompts else ""
        rows.append(
            f'<li class="card"><a href="sessions/{esc(s.sid)}.html"><span class="card__when">{when(started, True)}</span>'
            f'<span class="card__first">{esc(first)}</span>'
            f'<span class="card__facts">{len(s.prompts)} prompts · {s.tool_calls:,} tool calls · {len(s.subagents)} subagents · '
            f'{duration(started, last)} · <code>{esc(s.sid[:8])}</code></span></a></li>'
        )
    body = f"""<header class="mast"><h1>How it was built</h1>
<p class="mast__deck">The Claude Code sessions that built this repository, exported by the SessionEnd hook to
<code>docs/agent-log/</code>, newest first. A local view for people with access to the repository.</p></header>
<main class="sessions"><ol>{"".join(rows)}</ol></main>"""
    return page("How it was built", body)


CSS = r"""
:root{--paper:#fff;--sheet:#f3f4f2;--ink:#111;--muted:#5b6066;--rule:#d3d6d9;--accent:#e8590c;--user:#1f4e9a;
--display:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;--ui:"IBM Plex Sans",Arial,sans-serif;--mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--paper:#0f1113;--sheet:#191c1f;--ink:#eceeea;--muted:#a6acb2;--rule:#34393e;--user:#7fa8ee}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.55 var(--ui)}
a{color:inherit}code,pre{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.86em}

.toc ol{list-style:none;margin:.5rem 0 0;padding:0}.toc li a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2rem 1fr;gap:.3rem;padding:.3rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);text-decoration:none;font-size:.82rem}
.toc li a:hover .toc__t{text-decoration:underline}.toc__n{font:700 1rem var(--display);color:var(--muted)}

.turn--user .turn__who{color:var(--user)}.turn--user .prose{font-size:1rem}

details>summary{cursor:pointer}

.card__facts{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:52rem){.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.toc{position:static;max-height:40vh;border-right:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}}

JS = r"""
document.querySelectorAll("[data-toggle]").forEach((btn) => {
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const sel = btn.dataset.toggle === "tool" ? "details.tool" : "details.thinking";
    const all = [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)];
    const open = !all.every((d) => d.open);
    all.forEach((d) => (d.open = open));
    btn.textContent = (open ? "Collapse " : "Expand ") + (btn.dataset.toggle === "tool" ? "tool calls" : "thinking");
  });
});
const filter = document.querySelector(".toc__filter");
if (filter) filter.addEventListener("input", () => {
  const q = filter.value.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll(".toc li").forEach((li) => (li.hidden = q && !li.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
});
// A link into a collapsed subagent opens it.
addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
  const el = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
  if (el && el.tagName === "DETAILS") el.open = true;
});
"""


def build(log_dir: Path, out_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, list[Session]]:
    sessions = [parse_session(p) for p in sorted(log_dir.glob("*.md")) if p.name != "README.md"]
    sessions = [s for s in sessions if s.prompts]
    sessions.sort(key=lambda s: s.meta.get("Started", ""), reverse=True)
    (out_dir / "sessions").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "assets").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "assets" / "style.css").write_text(CSS.strip() + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (out_dir / "assets" / "app.js").write_text(JS.strip() + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    for s in sessions:
        (out_dir / "sessions" / f"{s.sid}.html").write_text(render_session(s), encoding="utf-8")
    index = out_dir / "index.html"
    index.write_text(render_index(sessions), encoding="utf-8")
    (out_dir / "sessions.json").write_text(
        json.dumps([{"session": s.sid, "prompts": len(s.prompts), "tool_calls": s.tool_calls, "subagents": len(s.subagents)}
                    for s in sessions], indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return index, sessions


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    parser.add_argument("--logs", type=Path, default=LOG_DIR, help="folder of exported sessions")
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=OUT_DIR, help="where to write the pages")
    parser.add_argument("--open", action="store_true", help="open the index in the browser")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    index, sessions = build(args.logs, args.out)
    for s in sessions:
        print(f"{s.sid[:8]}  {len(s.prompts):3d} prompts  {s.tool_calls:5d} tool calls  {len(s.subagents):2d} subagents")
    print(index)
    if args.open:
        webbrowser.open(index.as_uri())
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
```

`````
def test_turns_ignore_headings_inside_fences(tmp_path):
    s = session(tmp_path)
    assert [t.role for t in s.turns] == ["User", "Assistant", "User", "Assistant", "User"]
    assert s.meta["Branch"] == "main" and s.meta["Started"].startswith("2026-10-22")


def test_tool_calls_get_their_results_also_across_turns(tmp_path):
    s = session(tmp_path)
    bash, read = [g for t in s.turns for g in t.segments if g.kind == "tool"]
    assert bash.name == "Bash" and dict((k, v) for k, v, _ in bash.inputs)["description"] == "Read the notes"
    assert "## User <sub>not a turn" in dict((k, v) for k, v, _ in bash.inputs)["command"]

    assert read.result is not None and read.result.error and read.result.text == "no such file"
    assert not [g for t in s.turns for g in t.segments if g.kind == "result"]
    assert a.descriptor(bash) == "Read the notes"

    assert len(s.prompts) == 2 and a.first_line(s.prompts[1]) == "and also this"

    ]

    assert "after interrupting" in page and 'class="event"' in page
    assert page.count('class="tool') >= 2 and "Thinking" in page


def test_build_writes_the_site(tmp_path):

    (logs / "empty-0000.md").write_text("# Agent session empty\n\n| | |\n|---|---|\n", encoding="utf-8")
`````

**What it shows:**
- **Index:** the sessions, newest first, each with its date, first prompt, number of prompts, tool calls, subagents and length.
- **Session page:** a summary strip at the top, and a sidebar listing your prompts, numbered, with a filter box.
- **Your prompts:** prominent cards. Injected context, such as your global instructions, is collapsed rather than removed, since this stays private.
- **Claude's answers:** rendered Markdown. Thinking is collapsed.
- **Tool calls:** one line each, the tool name plus what it did (for example "Bash · Write the jq transcript-to-Markdown filter"). Clicking expands the input and the result; failed calls are marked in orange.
- **Messages the harness sends as you:** compact one-line events rather than prompts. These are background-task notifications, subagent reports, local commands like `/model`, interruptions and screenshot images. So the long session shows your 13 real prompts, not the 60 entries "User" in the log.
- **Subagents:** collapsible sections at the end, linked from the call that started each one.
- **Buttons** to expand or collapse all tool calls or all thinking, and light and dark following your system.

```
"""Statistics for the agent-log viewer: which tools were used, which shell commands the Bash
calls ran, and what each subagent actually did (grouped more finely than its agent type)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

# Bash builtins and keywords, shown apart from external programs.
BUILTINS = {
    ".", ":", "[", "[[", "alias", "bg", "break", "builtin", "case", "cd", "command", "continue", "declare",
    "echo", "eval", "exec", "exit", "export", "false", "fg", "for", "function", "getopts", "hash", "if",
    "jobs", "kill", "let", "local", "mapfile", "popd", "printf", "pushd", "pwd", "read", "readarray",
    "readonly", "return", "select", "set", "shift", "shopt", "source", "test", "time", "times", "trap",
    "true", "type", "typeset", "ulimit", "umask", "unalias", "unset", "until", "wait", "while",
}
# Words that continue a compound command; the command is the word after them.
CONTINUATIONS = {"do", "then", "else", "elif", "done", "fi", "esac", "in", "!", "{", "}"}
HEREDOC = re.compile(r"(?<!<)<<-?\s*(['\"]?)([A-Za-z_][\w-]*)\1")
WORD = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_./+-][\w.+-]*$")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- shell commands
def strip_heredocs(script: str) -> str:
    """Drop heredoc bodies: their lines are file contents (often Python), not commands."""
    lines = script.split("\n")
    out: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        out.append(line)
        terminators = [m.group(2) for m in HEREDOC.finditer(line)]
        i += 1
        for term in terminators:
            while i < len(lines) and lines[i].strip() != term:
                i += 1
            i += 1
    return "\n".join(out)


def split_quotes(script: str) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """The script with quoted strings and substitutions blanked out, and the inner scripts of
    $( ... ) and backtick substitutions (also those inside double quotes), which run too."""
    top: list[str] = []
    inner: list[str] = []
    i, n = 0, len(script)
    while i < n:
        c = script[i]
        if c == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
            top.append(" ")
            i += 2
        elif c == "'":
            j = script.find("'", i + 1)
            i = n if j < 0 else j + 1
            top.append(" Q ")
        elif c == '"':
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and script[j] != '"':
                if script[j] == "\\":
                    j += 1
                elif script.startswith("$(", j):
                    end = matching_paren(script, j + 1)
                    inner.append(script[j + 2 : end])
                    j = end
                j += 1
            i = j + 1
            top.append(" Q ")
        elif script.startswith("$(", i) and not script.startswith("$((", i):
            end = matching_paren(script, i + 1)
            inner.append(script[i + 2 : end])
            top.append(" Q ")
            i = end + 1
        elif c == "`":
            j = script.find("`", i + 1)
            if j > 0:
                inner.append(script[i + 1 : j])
            i = n if j < 0 else j + 1
            top.append(" Q ")
        elif c == "#" and (i == 0 or script[i - 1] in " \t\n;&|("):
            j = script.find("\n", i)
            i = n if j < 0 else j
        else:
            top.append(c)
            i += 1
    return "".join(top), inner


def matching_paren(s: str, open_at: int) -> int:
    depth, i = 0, open_at
    while i < len(s):
        if s[i] == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif s[i] == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i
        elif s[i] in "'\"":
            j = s.find(s[i], i + 1)
            i = len(s) if j < 0 else j
        i += 1
    return len(s) - 1


def shell_commands(script: str, depth: int = 0) -> list[str]:
    """The command (or builtin, keyword) that starts each simple command of a Bash script."""
    top, inner = split_quotes(strip_heredocs(script))
    top = re.sub(r"\d*[<>]&\d*|&>>?|\$\(\(.*?\)\)", " ", top)  # redirections like 2>&1, &>, arithmetic
    out: list[str] = []
    for segment in re.split(r"[\n;&|(){}]+", top):
        words = segment.split()
        while words and (words[0] in CONTINUATIONS or re.match(r"^\w+=", words[0])):
            words.pop(0)
        if not words:
            continue
        word = words[0]
        if word.startswith(("<", ">")):
            continue
        word = os.path.basename(word) if "/" in word and word not in ("/",) else word
        if word and word != "Q" and WORD.match(word):
            out.append(word)
    if depth < 3:
        for script_inside in inner:
            out += shell_commands(script_inside, depth + 1)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- files written
REDIRECT_FILE = re.compile(r"(?:^|[\s;&|])(?:cat|tee(?:\s+-a)?|printf[^>\n]*|echo[^>\n]*)?\s*>{1,2}\s*([\w./~-]+\.[\w]+|[\w./-]*Dockerfile[\w.-]*)")
LANGUAGE = {
    ".py": "Python", ".ts": "TypeScript", ".tsx": "TypeScript", ".js": "JavaScript", ".mjs": "JavaScript",
    ".css": "CSS", ".md": "docs", ".yml": "config", ".yaml": "config", ".json": "config", ".toml": "config",
    ".conf": "config", ".sh": "shell", ".jq": "shell", ".html": "HTML", ".csv": "data",
}


def files_written(tool_calls) -> list[str]:
    """Paths an agent wrote: Write/Edit targets and Bash redirections into files."""
    paths = []
    for seg in tool_calls:
        inputs = {k: v for k, v, _ in seg.inputs}
        if seg.name in ("Write", "Edit", "MultiEdit", "NotebookEdit") and inputs.get("file_path"):
            paths.append(inputs["file_path"])
        elif seg.name == "Bash":
            for m in REDIRECT_FILE.finditer(strip_heredocs(inputs.get("command", ""))):
                path = m.group(1)
                if not path.startswith(("/dev/", "/tmp/")) and "scratchpad" not in path:
                    paths.append(path)
    return paths


def language(path: str) -> str:
    if os.path.basename(path).startswith("Dockerfile"):
        return "config"
    return LANGUAGE.get(os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower(), "other")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- agent groups
@dataclass
class AgentProfile:
    description: str
    agent_type: str
    group: str
    tools: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)
    languages: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)

    @property
    def calls(self) -> int:
        return sum(self.tools.values())


GROUPS = [
    "Reviewed a pull request",
    "Researched sources on the web",
    "Fetched and archived data",
    "Wrote Python",
    "Wrote TypeScript / React",
    "Wrote tests",
    "Docker, CI and docs",
    "Other",
]


def classify(description: str, agent_type: str, tools: Counter, languages: Counter, commands: Counter) -> str:
    """A finer group than the agent type, from what the agent did: what it was asked
    (description), which tools it used and which files it wrote."""
    d = description.lower()
    web = tools["WebSearch"] + tools["WebFetch"]
    if d.startswith("review") or agent_type.endswith("reviewer"):
        return "Reviewed a pull request"
    if web >= 3 or re.search(r"\b(survey|research|investigat)", d):
        return "Researched sources on the web"
    if re.search(r"\b(fetch|refetch|download|manifest|scrape|archive)", d) or (commands["curl"] + commands["wget"]) >= 5:
        return "Fetched and archived data"
    if re.search(r"\b(e2e|playwright|tests?)\b", d):
        return "Wrote tests"
    if re.search(r"\b(docker|readme|ci|workflow|docs?)\b", d):
        return "Docker, CI and docs"
    code = {k: v for k, v in languages.items() if k in ("Python", "TypeScript", "JavaScript", "CSS")}
    if code:
        top = max(code, key=code.get)
        return "Wrote Python" if top == "Python" else "Wrote TypeScript / React"
    if re.search(r"\b(frontend|view|ui|react|q\d)\b", d):
        return "Wrote TypeScript / React"
    if re.search(r"\b(pipeline|engine|api|parser|sample|billable)\b", d):
        return "Wrote Python"
    return "Other"


def profile_agent(description: str, agent_type: str, turns) -> AgentProfile:
    calls = [g for t in turns for g in t.segments if g.kind == "tool"]
    tools = Counter(g.name for g in calls if g.name != "SubagentHandback")
    languages = Counter(language(p) for p in files_written(calls))
    commands = Counter(c for g in calls if g.name == "Bash" for c in shell_commands({k: v for k, v, _ in g.inputs}.get("command", "")))
    group = classify(description, agent_type, tools, languages, commands)
    return AgentProfile(description, agent_type, group, tools, languages)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- whole sessions
@dataclass
class Stats:
    tools: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)
    commands: Counter = field(default_factory=Counter)
    agents: list[AgentProfile] = field(default_factory=list)

    def add(self, other: "Stats") -> None:
        self.tools.update(other.tools)
        self.commands.update(other.commands)
        self.agents.extend(other.agents)


def session_stats(session) -> Stats:
    stats = Stats()
    all_turns = session.turns + [t for sub in session.subagents for t in sub.turns]
    for t in all_turns:
        for g in t.segments:
            if g.kind != "tool" or g.name == "SubagentHandback":
                continue
            stats.tools[g.name] += 1
            if g.name == "Bash":
                stats.commands.update(shell_commands({k: v for k, v, _ in g.inputs}.get("command", "")))
    stats.agents = [profile_agent(sub.description or sub.name, sub.agent_type, sub.turns) for sub in session.subagents]
    return stats

```

```
"""Tests for tools/agent_log_stats.py: shell command counting, files written, agent groups.

    uv run --no-project --with markdown-it-py --with pytest pytest tools
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter

import pytest

import agent_log_stats as st
from agent_log_html import Segment


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("script", "expected"),
    [
        ("cd /x && git status --short | head -5", ["cd", "git", "head"]),
        ('for f in *.md; do echo "$f"; done', ["for", "echo"]),
        ("while read -r l; do printf '%s' \"$l\"; done < x", ["while", "read", "printf"][:1] + ["printf"]),
        ("cat > a.py <<'EOF'\nimport os; rm -rf /\nEOF\npython3 a.py 2>&1 | tail -3", ["cat", "python3", "tail"]),
        ('X=1 uv run pytest -q && echo "ok $(git rev-parse HEAD)"', ["uv", "echo", "git"]),
        ("ls `which python3`  # comment; rm x", ["ls", "which"]),
        ("find . -name '*.py' | xargs grep -n 'a; b' | wc -l", ["find", "xargs", "wc"]),
        ("if [ -f x ]; then sed -i 's/a/b/' x; fi", ["if", "sed"]),
        ('dl(){ curl -o "$1" "$2"; }\ndl a b\nfunction get { wget x; }\nget y', ["curl", st.SHELL_FUNCTION, "wget", st.SHELL_FUNCTION]),
        ("/usr/bin/env python3 x.py", ["env"]),
    ],
)
def test_shell_commands(script, expected):
    assert st.shell_commands(script) == expected


def call(name, **inputs):
    return Segment("tool", name=name, inputs=[(k, v, "\n" in v) for k, v in inputs.items()])


def test_files_written_through_tools_and_bash():
    calls = [
        call("Write", file_path="backend/app/x.py"),
        call("Bash", command="cat > frontend/src/A.tsx <<'EOF'\nconst x = 1 > 0;\nEOF\necho hi > /tmp/scratch.txt"),
        call("Bash", command="printf 'a' >> docs/NOTES.md && cat Dockerfile"),
    ]
    paths = st.files_written(calls)
    assert paths == ["backend/app/x.py", "frontend/src/A.tsx", "docs/NOTES.md"]
    assert [st.language(p) for p in paths] == ["Python", "TypeScript", "docs"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("description", "agent_type", "tools", "languages", "commands", "group"),
    [
        ("Review PR 17 engine and API", "code-reviewer", {}, {}, {}, "Reviewed a pull request"),
        ("Survey UPS published rate data", "general-purpose", {"WebSearch": 8}, {}, {}, "Researched sources on the web"),
        ("Build raw manifest and refetch PDFs", "general-purpose", {}, {}, {"curl": 30}, "Fetched and archived data"),
        ("Issue 8: Playwright e2e and screenshots", "general-purpose", {}, {"TypeScript": 9}, {}, "Wrote tests"),
        ("Issue 7: Docker and README", "general-purpose", {}, {"config": 4}, {"curl": 9}, "Docker, CI and docs"),
        ("Issue 5: Q1 quote and Q2 breakeven", "general-purpose", {}, {"TypeScript": 19, "Python": 1}, {"curl": 9}, "Wrote TypeScript / React"),
        ("Build FedEx rate pipeline", "general-purpose", {}, {"Python": 6}, {}, "Wrote Python"),
        ("Tidy up", "general-purpose", {}, {}, {}, "Other"),
    ],
)
def test_groups_are_finer_than_the_agent_type(description, agent_type, tools, languages, commands, group):
    assert st.classify(description, agent_type, Counter(tools), Counter(languages), Counter(commands)) == group
```

The viewer now has statistics, and the length is gone from both the session pages and the index. It's committed on branch `agent-log-viewer` (`436686e`), on top of the viewer; neither is pushed yet. To look: `~/parcel-rates-label-redesign/build/agent-log/index.html`.

**Where the stats appear:** the index shows them open, totalled across all sessions. Each session page has the same panel, collapsed above the log, so the conversation stays at the top.

**Tools:** calls per tool, subagents included. Across the two sessions with prompts: Bash 1,615, Read 229, Write 39, WebSearch 35, Agent 30, WebFetch 23, and so on.

**Shell commands:** the program or builtin that starts each command in every Bash call. Builtins and keywords are coloured blue (`cd`, `echo`, `for`, `while`, `printf`…) and programs black. The top entries are `cd`, `grep`, `head`, `git`, `echo` and `cat`. To keep the counts honest:
- Heredoc bodies are skipped, so Python written through `cat > file <<'EOF'` doesn't count as shell commands.
- Quoted text and comments are skipped.
- Commands inside `$( … )` and backticks are counted.
- Functions an agent defined in its own script count as one "(shell function)" entry (189 calls), instead of showing up as fake commands such as `dl` or `get`.

**Subagents by what they did:** 30 subagents, almost all labelled `general-purpose` or as reviewers, now in seven groups:

| Group | Subagents |
|---|---|
| Reviewed a pull request | 15 |
| Wrote Python | 5 |
| Wrote TypeScript / React | 4 |
| Researched sources on the web | 3 |
| Fetched and archived data | 1 |
| Wrote tests | 1 |
| Docker, CI and docs | 1 |

The grouping uses each agent's task description, the tools it used, and the files it wrote, whether through the Write tool or through Bash. Below the chart, a table lists every agent under its group with its agent type, tool calls, most-used tools and file types written.

One judgement call: `curl` counts as evidence of fetching data only when nothing else fits. Agents that built the frontend or the Docker setup also used `curl`, to test the API, and were misgrouped as fetchers in my first pass.

24 tests pass (19 of them new, for the stats), and ruff is clean.
